key_insight: In simulated worlds with altered physics, LLMs struggled to independently notice anomalies and discover the hidden laws without research prompts or hints.
engineering_relevance: Autonomous scientific agents need stronger anomaly detection and experiment design to investigate unexpected behavior without predefined objectives.
method: LongChang generates simulated scenes with one or more altered physical laws.
Explorer LLMs manipulate objects and build tools to investigate self-chosen questions.
Separate agents review scenes, tools, and reports, using exploration records to guide scene evolution.
evidence_signal: Across 12 evaluated LLMs, GPT-6-Astra achieved a 16.7% discovery rate and the other 11 scored 0%; exploration records showed missed anomalies and partial law identification.
watch_item: Results rely on simulated physics and LLM-based evaluation, so they do not establish performance in real-world scientific discovery.
paper_title: Can LLMs Uncover Hidden Physical Laws through Free Exploration?
